episodes.title: What a Night for a Knight
episodes.summary: Scooby Doo and Shaggy Rogers stumble across a lone suit of black armor and embark on a quest to find the artifact's missing owner.

episodes.title: A Clue for Scooby Doo
episodes.summary: Scooby and the gang become mixed up in a mystery when he surfs into what appears to be the ghost of Captain Cutler.

episodes.title: Hassle in the Castle
episodes.summary: The sleuths shipwreck on a deserted island and explore a haunted castle.

episodes.title: Mine Your Own Business
episodes.summary: The gang explores a mining town and investigate a phantom miner who's driving the business away from a nearby dude ranch.

episodes.title: Decoy for a Dognapper
episodes.summary: Scooby impersonates a prize-winning Great Dane to catch whoever is stealing show dogs.

episodes.title: What the Hex Going On?
episodes.summary: When the gang visits the Weatherby estate, they must investigate a mysterious voice and a ghost who demands the family return its fortune to a neighboring clan.

episodes.title: Never Ape an Ape Man
episodes.summary: The gang is hired by Daphne's uncle, a famous director, as extras in his latest project. But the star of the show is a real, nasty ape.

episodes.title: Foul Play in Funland
episodes.summary: The gang investigates a haunted seaside amusement park.

episodes.title: The Backstage Rage
episodes.summary: A sinister puppet master manipulates the gang's investigation of a case of counterfeit.

episodes.title: Bedlam in the Big Top
episodes.summary: A ghost clown haunts a small circus, using hypnotism to bend locals to his will.

episodes.title: A Gaggle of Galloping Ghosts
episodes.summary: The gang visits Franken Castle, which seems to be crowded with famous inhabitants Dracula, the Monster and Wolf Man.

episodes.title: Scooby Doo and a Mummy, Too
episodes.summary: The gang helps a professor set up an ancient Egypt exhibit, but the star of the display keeps vanishing.

episodes.title: Which Witch is Which?
episodes.summary: A zombie walks in front of the Mystery Machine as the gang heads into the bayou for a fishing trip, leading to a real witch hunt.

episodes.title: Go Away Ghost Ship
episodes.summary: The gang sets out to solve the mystery of a ghostly pirate seemingly bent on avenging his capture by a shipping magnate's ancestor.

episodes.title: Spooky Space Kook
episodes.summary: The gang stumbles across a UFO's landing site when the Mystery Machine runs out of gas on a deserted road.

episodes.title: A Night of Fright is No Delight
episodes.summary: Scooby must spend the night in a haunted house in order to receive an inheritance.

episodes.title: That's Snow Ghost
episodes.summary: A ski trip turns spooky for the gang when they run into the ghostly Yeti Beast, and a Tibetan hermit who says he is responsible for summoning the monster.

episodes.title: Nowhere to Hyde
episodes.summary: The gang follows a mysterious figure through a marsh to the house of a latter-day Dr. Jekyl, whose alter ego is apparently a jewel thief.

episodes.title: Mystery Mask Mix-Up
episodes.summary: When Daphne innocently buys a mask that once belonged to an ancient warlord, the gang finds itself pursued by zombies and ghosts.

episodes.title: Scooby's Night with a Frozen Fright
episodes.summary: Shaggy and Scooby hook a frozen caveman and present the chilly artifact to Oceanland. But the creature is mysteriously thawed out and goes on a rampage.

episodes.title: Jeepers It's the Creeper
episodes.summary: The kids look for a ghostly bank robber who seems able to walk through walls.

episodes.title: Haunted House Hang-Up
episodes.summary: The gang investigates a haunted southern mansion when the Mystery Machine overheats and strands them nearby.

episodes.title: A Tiki Scare Is No Fair
episodes.summary: A Hawaiian vacation turns into another investigation when Scooby and Shag are threatened by a witch doctor.

episodes.title: Who's Afraid of the Big Bad Werewolf
episodes.summary: The gang goes camping and stumbles across a lonely graveyard and an empty tomb whose missing inhabitant was suspected of being a werewolf.

episodes.title: Don't Fool with a Phantom
episodes.summary: A phantom interrupts Shaggy and Scooby's performance on a TV dance show.
